portfolio_rules: Models first because throughput is higher and publishing friction is lower than plugins.
One reusable core may power multiple SKUs, but each listing must solve a distinct buyer problem.
No Brookhaven-specific art, UI, names, proprietary assets, school-specific content, private data, or unverified third-party code.
A weak SKU does not earn extra engineering merely because time was already spent on it.
Sales, reviews, support requests and repeat demand outrank internal completion metrics.

skus.name: Quiz & Reward Engine
skus.buyer_problem: Creators need a drop-in quiz system with randomized questions, server-side answer validation and configurable rewards.
skus.reuse_source: Original implementation informed by generic quiz-engine lessons.
skus.reuse_boundary: No ABVM questions, school-specific content, Brookhaven material, private data or third-party runtime code.
skus.build_prompt: Use the existing original Quiz & Reward Engine v1.0 artifact. Preserve its dependency-free source and verified SHA. Complete only the remaining Roblox Creator Store upload/listing steps, keep the $3.99 launch price, and do not alter product code unless a new runtime defect is reproduced.

skus.name: House Controls Pack
skus.buyer_problem: Roleplay builders repeatedly reimplement house lights, locks, garage and recolor controls.
skus.reuse_source: Original implementation informed by generic failure cases observed in prior roleplay-game engineering.
skus.reuse_boundary: No Brookhaven assets, UI, names, proprietary structure, StarBlox source, or third-party runtime code.

build_evidence.defect_fix: release session-owned house when owner leaves

skus.build_prompt: Use the existing original House Controls Pack v1.0 artifact. Run the documented Roblox Studio runtime QA matrix for ownership isolation, lights, garage, lock enforcement, recolor, replay/spam resistance and mobile controls. Fix only reproduced defects. Do not publish until runtime QA passes.

skus.name: Redeem Code System
skus.buyer_problem: Creators need a small safe configurable code-redemption mechanic with expiration and one-time-per-player persistence.
skus.reuse_source: Original implementation using generic server-authority and idempotency patterns.
skus.reuse_boundary: Original implementation only; no external runtime dependency.

build_evidence.defect_fix: atomic one-time redemption reservation closes concurrent double-grant race

skus.build_prompt: Use the existing original Redeem Code System v1.0 artifact. Run the documented Roblox Studio runtime QA for valid/invalid codes, expiration, one-time persistence, DataStore failure behavior, replay protection, two-player isolation and mobile controls. Fix only reproduced defects. Do not publish until runtime QA passes.

skus.name: Question Bank Rotator
skus.buyer_problem: Randomized no-repeat question rotation is useful, but it is stronger as part of Quiz & Reward Engine than as a separate first-batch product.
skus.build_prompt: Do not build separately unless buyer evidence later shows demand for a standalone question-bank component.

skus.name: House Claim System
skus.buyer_problem: Roleplay creators need plot claiming and occupancy state, but current paid competition is stronger than the first-batch alternatives.
skus.reuse_boundary: No Brookhaven assets, UI, names or proprietary structure.
skus.build_prompt: Revisit only after live sales/support evidence from the first three products.

skus.name: Starter Shop System
skus.buyer_problem: Creators need shop systems, but the current Creator Store category is crowded with low-cost alternatives.
skus.reuse_boundary: No copied commercial game assets or UI.
skus.build_prompt: Do not build until buyer evidence justifies competing in a crowded category.

skus.name: Mobile HUD Starter
skus.buyer_problem: Mobile UI problems are common, but current paid/free tooling competition is comparatively strong.
skus.reuse_boundary: Create wholly original Roblox UI if revived.
skus.build_prompt: Hold unless a narrower unmet mobile use case is identified.

skus.name: Vibe Game Inspector
skus.buyer_problem: AI-assisted Roblox creators need objective detection of common structural, mobile, client/server and release defects.
skus.reuse_source: Failure-pattern lessons plus original inspection rules.
skus.reuse_boundary: No copying third-party plugin code or assets.
skus.build_prompt: Prototype only after the model launch batch produces marketplace evidence.

factory_guardrails.launch_batch_rule: SKU-001 through SKU-003 are the only first-batch products.
factory_guardrails.shipping_rule: Do not ship Cmdr, test-runner, coverage, Rojo runtime code, or other third-party dependencies unless a specific product-level need and license review justify it.
